name: eu-mdr-skills
description: Statute-verified skills for EU medical device regulation. Every finding cites verbatim text retrieved from EUR-Lex or gesetze-im-internet, and every skill ships an eval suite measured against a no-plugin baseline.

plugins.name: device-claims
plugins.description: Reviews device and IVD marketing copy against MDR/IVDR Art. 7, HWG § 3 and § 11, and UWG § 5 and § 6.

plugins.name: mdr-classification
plugins.description: Classifies medical device software under MDR Annex VIII implementing rule 3.3 and Rule 11.

plugins.name: scope-statement
plugins.description: Bounds a compliance claim: what was checked, what was not, and what the result does not establish.

plugins.name: mpdg-germany
plugins.description: What Germany requires on top of MDR: language rules, supplementary DMIDS notifications, supplementary vigilance duties.

plugins.name: mdr-transition
plugins.description: How long a legacy device may still be placed on the market, under Art. 120 as amended by 2023/607.
